AnchoredGroupEditor.note: Ported from the manual chat-group editor: a popover-frame panel pinned at a measured point over its host pane, with a real Input and ghost/primary footer. The position prop is doing visible work.

AnchoredContextMenu.note: Menu anchored over a branch list at top/left — shows the layer overlapping content the way a context menu does, with a highlighted row and a destructive row.

CornerLayers.note: Four layers at all four corners of one host — the clearest possible read of the position axis (top/right/bottom/left), each a legible DS chip.

FixedOverlayBar.note: position:fixed with bottom+left+right stretches the bar across its containing block and pins it to the bottom; content, Discard and Commit all render.
